hypothesis: structural distance is a lossy projection of proof-continuation state; replay-valid generations may create or rediscover continuation-interface classes before structural contraction

continuation_interface.unit: a term's set of replay-valid one-step source-law interactions

decision_table.INTERFACE_PRECEDES_GEOMETRY: a generation adds continuation-interface classes while minimum structural distance remains 2, and a later generation contracts
decision_table.INTERFACE_GROWTH_WITHOUT_GEOMETRY: new continuation-interface classes appear but no structural contraction occurs by generation 3
decision_table.LATE_QUOTIENT_REDISCOVERY: large syntactic growth occurs with little or no continuation-interface growth and repeated interface classes dominate
decision_table.TRUE_CONTINUATION_GRAMMAR_OBSTRUCTION: neither meaningful syntactic reach nor continuation-interface novelty appears under the declared replay-valid depth-3 closure
decision_table.DIRECT_CONTRACTION: a replay-valid generated consequence reaches structural distance <=1 immediately; retain separately from the interface claim

scientific_rule: P_depth3 is diagnostic. Do not promote a depth3 constructor merely because depth was searched. Use the observed interface-growth pattern to decide whether the next residual is multi-generation attachment, late quotient/access, or continuation-grammar obstruction.
